meta.product: ILOSTAT EAP TEAP: Labour force by sex and age; Labour force by sex and education; Labour force by sex and rural / urban areas; Labour force by sex and marital status
meta.coverage: Labour force by sex and age; Labour force by sex and education; Labour force by sex and rural / urban areas; Labour force by sex and marital status. HS - National Sample Survey, annual
meta.revisionPolicy: Each ILOEST edition re-estimates the whole modelled history; the raw dump of the previous edition is archived under data/raw/vintages. Survey series change when the ILO reprocesses the unit data.
meta.note: Computed by the ILO from NSS unit-level data. Each round runs July to June and is labelled by the year it ends (2012 = July 2011 to June 2012). Observations flagged U are ones the ILO itself marks unreliable.
sourceNotes: Data reference period: Noncalendar year (501 obs.)
Break in series: Methodology revised (165 obs.)
